tools.title: GPU renderer
tools.description: The apps' own GPU renderer (mgu-render): draws them at 60 fps, beside the MGU Store's Renderer; installed with the apps (iDrive 7 and iDrive 8)

tools.title: Controller gate
tools.description: Lets the apps have the iDrive controller (tabs, page buttons, settings, Doom); loads into the HMI at the next start (iDrive 7 and iDrive 8)
